text:
kim: Follow-up from the postmortem thread  we agreed on three mitigation tracks (auth provider resilience, model-registry degraded mode, recurrence detection + alerts). Need final owners and concrete short timelines.

arnav: I can own vendor engagement & SLA ask. I'll extract token-endpoint SLAs and request a vendor remediation plan with milestones. Plan to post initial findings in the epic today. INF-4601.

riley: I'll take the registry degraded-mode engineering: read-only fallback, warm LRU cache for top-20 models, and a rollback script (feature-flag off + cache purge). Draft runbook + staging harness for TTL sims by next Wed. INF-4602.

tamara: I'll lead auth hardening: short-lived tokens, jittered refresh, client-side token caching with safe TTLs, and a circuit-breaker around issuer calls. Need Security sign-off on rotation cadence. Target 9 business days for staged rollout. INF-4603.

infra-bot: Created epic: https://tracker.internal/INF-4600 "Dependency resilience: auth & registry". Tasks INF-4601..INF-4606.

kim: Two operational asks: (1) add a composite alert correlating auth_p95 with registry_fetch_errors, (2) schedule a monthly recurrence review and a 90-day rolling dashboard.

arnav: I'll loop in Legal after vendor sends remediations. Recommend we ask for a specific RTO/RPO for token endpoints and a remediation cadence.

riley: Note on cache TTLs  aggressive TTLs can cause model drift. I'll include a staged replay harness that replays last month's requests and measures output divergence vs TTL. Will include sampling to check quality.

tamara: I will coordinate with Product on acceptable staleness thresholds and create a small degradation matrix (cache-first, read-only, deny). @kim can you assign Product reviewer?

kim: Assigned @product_lead to review; please have sign-off criteria in 4 business days.

infra-bot: Added alert rule to epic: (auth_p95 > 200ms && registry_fetch_error_rate > 1%) sustained 5m -> page. Also added 90-day rolling dashboard. INF-4604.

riley: I'll also add a canary traffic test in staging to validate quality impact before enabling degraded-mode in prod. INF-4605.

arnav: If vendor timeline is weak, I'll escalate to account execs and request a contractual uptime clause for critical token endpoints. Legal: please prepare for a rapid review when INF-4601 gets vendor reply.

legal: Will prioritize review. Ask vendor to include their mitigation steps for throttles and an internal runbook snippet.

kim: Action summary (INF-4600 epic):
- arnav: vendor SLA & remediation ask (INF-4601)  48h
- riley: registry degraded-mode + TTL sim + rollback (INF-4602, INF-4605)  next Wed
- tamara: auth hardening + token-caching + security sign-off (INF-4603)  9 business days
- infra-bot: composite alert + dashboard (INF-4604)  3 days
- product_lead: staleness sign-off  4 business days

kim: I'll consolidate these into the epic and run a weekly check-in until INF-46xx are closed. Please add any blockers to the epic and ping if you need more runway. Closing thread and moving tracking to INF-4600. :white_check_mark:
